scenarios.name: Search while the drawing browser floats

scenario_steps.name: a drawing with browser entries is open in the MCAD Software
the drawing browser floats over the drawing sheet
the user opens the floating browser search field
the user enters a query that matches no drawing browser entry
the floating browser displays a no-results message instead of its tree
the drawing sheet remains visible behind the browser
the user clears the search text
the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed in the floating panel
the user closes the empty search field
the browser remains floating over the sheet
